event: He gets up and turns back to the den, the dead maul on his back and the lantern at his belt.
He works the strip between the stair and the drop: slimed packs, boots, picked bones.
A double handful of sound metal comes out of the rot, and he folds it away as forge-stock.

make.title: Reclaimed den-metal (forge-stock)
make.description: A double handful of fire-cleaned scrap: belt-buckles, a pitted eating-knife, nails, an iron clasp.

event: He pushes heat through the lantern-flame into the fouled heap and burns it clean.

memory.fact: The False Haven is dark but for fire brought into it.
The False Haven is dark but for fire brought into it.

event: The smoke thins: the drop lies open and sheer, and all he came back for is on its far side.
Across it his ember-sense snags a faint live warmth, banked low in the dark past the drop.
